chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: In this lesson, we're going to look at optimizers.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: Optimizers sound scary, but they're really cool and really fun.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: I'm going to show you all kinds of neat things you can do with optimizers.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: What is an optimizer?

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: An optimizer is an algorithm that can do the following things.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: Optimizers can be used to find minimum values for functions.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: So say you have a function like f of x equals x squared plus x cubed plus 5 or

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: something like that.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: An optimizer can find for what value of x is this overall function minimized.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: Another thing that optimizers can do is find the parameters for

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: parameterized models from data.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: So we might have some data from some experiment and

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: we can use optimizers to find a polynomial fit to that data.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: And that's actually one thing we're going to learn in this lesson.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: Finally, we can use an optimizer to refine allocations to stocks and portfolios.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: So what does that mean?

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: Well that means for instance, you can decide what percentage of funds should be

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: allocated to each stock using an optimizer.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: How do we use an optimizer?

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: It's really just as simple as three key steps.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: First thing you need to do is define a function that you want to minimize.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: As an example, you might use something like f of x is equal to x squared plus 0.5.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: You define that in Python and then the minimizer will call this function many,

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: many times as it tries to find the minimum value for x that causes this function overall to be smallest.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: You also need to start with an initial guess for x that you think might be close to the solution to the problem.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: If you don't really know, then you can choose a random value or just some standard value.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: But then the optimizer starts with that guess and it repeatedly, again,

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: it repeatedly calls a function, tests different values, and narrows in on the solution.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: Finally, you call the optimizer with these parameters and

chunks.title: What is an optimizer
chunks.text: stand back while it searches for the minimum.
